title: Chapter 965
paragraphs: Chapter 965
Episode 238. Atonement and Letters (2)
I could never have imagined that a letter would come from Sharon.
"I heard that Sir Sharon overcame the Demon Castle, but is he congratulating you for climbing Genesis!?"
"Wow, Sir Sharon congratulates? It's hard to imagine."
Dante and Veradine said.
"I don't think it's that. He probably has something to tell me. Jet, prepare the Red Owl."
"Valeria and Sandra just took that a while ago. Instead, since Syris came to check the documents a while ago, you can take the Mort, Master."
Jin took the note given by Veradine.
"I'll check the letter first and then look at this, Veradine. Take care of yourself."
"Got it. I'll be playing with Dante for a while, so come and have a drink in the evening."
"What kind of drink for a guy who hasn't even fully recovered from his injuries?"
"It's best to heal when it's warm inside."
Jin chuckled and went to find Syris. She had just come out of Casimir's office.
"Jin? I was about to see you."
"I didn't even know you were here, I would have been disappointed if you had just left."
"You would be. Looking at your face, you have somewhere to go?"
"Yes, actually, I urgently need to go to the Garden of Swords to receive a letter from my father."
"Oh, I was going to stop by the Garden of Swords to see the first generation. The training that started during the demon invasion is still ongoing. Well, let's go."
[Vooong.]
As Jin climbed on, Mort opened a white dimensional gate. Sitting behind Syris and riding through the Interworld Wilderness was now as comfortable as a walk.
"But a letter... It seems Sir Sharon has really changed. Is he trying to congratulate your Genesis?"
"I doubt it."

"Hmm, I hope there is at least one line about mother in that letter. You know? Mother seems to be a bit disappointed in Sir Sharon. The only two people who could be called friends of my mother were Sir Sharon and Sir Ron."
"I know well. I haven't heard much, but I heard that my father often talked about Sir Talaris to Sister Luna."
"I heard from the first generation about that. If there's a part where Sir Sharon describes about my mother, be sure to let me know."
"Indeed. Speaking of which, I heard that Talarius is almost fully recovered now."
"Yes, he's greatly recovered. The wound left by Bidelruce or something was not fatal at all. He's already dating new lovers."
"I heard that when I last communicated with Talarius. He said he's making some interesting friends these days."
"Those interesting friends are dragons. Young dragons, about a thousand years old."
"Young dragons…?"
"It's strange. Dragons without an affiliation are rare."
As Syris said, it was odd for dragons to suddenly loiter near the fortress.

Most of the currently active dragons are with Zipple. However, the fact that they fit well with Talarius meant they were neither affiliated with Zipple nor showed a hostile tendency towards the fortress.
"Your mother also said she'll have to talk to you about this soon."
"Understood. I hope the meeting with the dragons goes well."
Mort arrived at the Sword Garden.
"The first generation would also need to see Chiron's letter, so I have to wait a bit longer. See you later, Jin."
"Yes, Sir Syris."
At that time, Sandra, who had trouble getting to the Sword Garden to meet Jin, was heading back to Tikan. Therefore, she could not meet Jin at the Sword Garden either.
"Have you arrived, Prince?"
The leaders and elders were waiting in Leuth's office. They were all waiting for Jin's arrival.
"Did the prince arrive? I thought the kid would die from impatience. It seems this friend has had a lot of trouble bringing this."
Balas said, patting a knight's shoulder.
"Sir Khan...!?"

The strongest mailman of this age, the guardian knight Khan, who had been watching Jin from the storm city, and had delivered Kasimir's letters via the Black Sea throughout his candidate knight period, was kneeling on one knee.
"I, Guardian Knight Khan of Runcandel, greet the Prince. Please call me by my name."
There was an indomitable aura emanating from Khan, not seen before. It was natural that many trials during the Black Sea expedition would have hardened him.
Whenever Khan delivered letters, he fought against the Black Sea monsters, but this time his clothes were clean.
The monsters in the early and mid stages of the Black Sea were no match for him, and his clean appearance was thanks to Chiron paving the way and granting him protection.
"Seeing your majestic figure in person somehow makes me emotional."
"You've been through a lot, Sir Khan. You've become strong...strong enough to wear a black helmet."
Jin said, looking at the black helmet that Khan was holding. After Luna and the black knights returned to the Sword Garden, Chiron immediately appointed him as a black knight.
"Thank you. I'd like to stay and be of service to you, but I need to return to the prince as soon as you check the letter."
Khan handed a neck guard to Jin. The sealed letter inside it was quite thick.
Jin looked down at the letter silently for a while. He envisioned Chiron writing the letter on the most desolate land in the world.
"I see."
[We will leave if the prince wishes.]
"No, head of household, let's read it together."
Suppressing his trembling heart, Jin broke the seal.
Surprisingly, the first sentence began with a congratulatory message that only Jin could not have imagined.
(To my youngest son.
Just now, as I write this letter, I felt your energy finally reaching the sky. If I were in the family, I would have held a second party for you.
Congratulations.)
At that moment, Jin regretted not asking everyone to leave. He felt like crying, but he barely held it back. However, he couldn't help but get teary-eyed.
"…I never thought I would live to hear such praise from my father."
The Tona brothers, without knowing, pulled out a handkerchief and wiped Jin's eyes from both sides.
"There's a bit of a salty feel to it. You've ascended, but these few lines are all you get."
[That's right, Luna. Haha, my grandson, but even if you prick him, not a drop of blood will come out.]
(Firstly, as a senior who has reached the Ascension before being a father, I will give you some tips.
As you know, Ascension can be eroded by devilishness at any time. I too, for a long time, was lost in devilishness and lost my humanity... I will introduce you to the best ways to prevent that.
First, do not live like a beast.
To explain in detail, try to use appropriate utensils when eating, even if your eyes are bright, it's good to wear glasses when reading, and always dress according to the occasion and formality.)
At that point, everyone's eyes widened. It was a random conversation.
"…Utensils? Glasses? Clothes? Khan, is this really what my father wrote?"
"Yes, First Generation."

"Hmm, now that I think about it, my father did often wear glasses when he was in the study. I never thought about it, but looking back, it's strange, isn't it? He should be able to see thousands of steps away as if it's right in front of him, but glasses?"
"(……This might seem strange. However, these mundane activities serve to preserve our humanity.
Becoming a Ascended and stepping into the semi-godly realm means that many elements necessary for humans become unnecessary.
Even without a fork and knife, you can create edible food just by invoking life force (even this is more convenient), and no matter how good the book, your withered soul barely reacts.
Even if you dress like a beggar for a formal gathering, everyone will revere you. You gradually forget what is necessary as a human.
That's the state of Ascension I experienced. An Ascended human must focus on these insignificant actions every moment, or else they naturally become a beast.
Therefore, when eating food, you must always try to enjoy it as much as possible, and when reading, you must immerse yourself in the sensation of reading......)
"Ah... so that's why."
[Only those who have experienced the demonic realm can give such advice, great-grandson.]
Jin and his siblings were recalling images of their father, Chiron, spending time in the Sword Garden.
In retrospect, Chiron always insisted on Rosa's cooking when he came to the Sword Garden, and he always spent an unusually long time on meals.
In the study, he always wore glasses, and whether he was wearing casual clothes or formal wear, his attire never seemed out of place.
(I didn't have many moments to do so.
As you know, I had a destiny given to me since my youth, so I always had to travel the Black Sea.
Of course, in the Black Sea, you can't have a proper meal, immerse yourself in reading, meet people in proper attire. All that's in the Black Sea are the remnants of monsters and witches.)
So I'm sorry for not being a good father to you.
Such words were not written.
However, it didn't feel blatantly or resentful to the children.
Rather, it was a feeling of pity. The children of Runcandel were feeling compassion for their father for the first time.
It was a strange feeling. Objectively, Chiron was a terrible father, always brutally cold.

Yet, the children felt sympathy for him because they were beginning to understand the weight of destiny. All the remaining children were overcoming their respective destinies. From the beginning, Runcandel was far from being a typical family.
(……The Black Sea expedition is going smoothly.
Now only the fragments named Nirgand and Morganie are left. We've been tracking the incarnations of Nirgand since the day before yesterday, so we should be able to get rid of him soon.
However, I have obtained a new piece of information while exploring the Black Sea recently.
It's that the Sword of the Duke, Barisada, is a key to unlock some hidden space in the Black Sea. And that space seems to be the work of Lokia Ganesto, a former knight of our family.)
Jin couldn't help but recall the conversation he had within the picture of Keitam."
